label: Content-fixed favouring laws, from the definitions
description: A placed diagnostic for 608a262d. It supplies a contrastive standard on which the explanans is individuated independently of the outcome partition: the re-description of the outcome that meets the determination standard (SelectionScope law 8) is outcome-dependent and so is not admitted; law 1 adds that no admitted content with asymmetric (net) favouring selects whatever outcome occurs (the #742 incompatible core on choice cells), which every account fails alike. Good-bounded favouring explains no contrast between outcomes that the standard ties and selects nothing when every outcome is bettered, whoever the source; a content that is not good-bounded (a bias) can select. Establishes no premise.
